## Summary

Add `awesome-corporate-standards` as a standards and frameworks reference resource.

## Why this fits

This repository complements compliance tooling and platform entries with a curated map of the standards, frameworks, and certification bodies those tools are often built around. It is especially relevant for readers navigating ISO, NIST, GDPR, SOC, PCI DSS, ESG, GRC, and sector-specific organizational standards.
